title: One in five white evangelicals view the label favorably
subtitle: View of "Christian nationalism," white evangelicals and all U.S. adults, April 2026
caption: One in five white evangelicals (20%) view Christian nationalism favorably and about as many (18%) view it unfavorably. The largest group, 38%, say they have never heard of it.
note: Question: all in all, do you have a favorable or unfavorable view of "Christian nationalism"? Asked of those who had heard of the term; the others are shown as never heard of it. Don't know enough includes no answer. Pew figures, drawn by Christian Curator from the published report.

sources.study: How Americans Feel About Religion's Influence in Government and Public Life
sources.sample: 3,592 U.S. adults; margin of error plus or minus 1.9 percentage points for the full sample
